mapper.sql: id, division_id, stage_id, batch_version, grouping_mode, grouping_status, active_unique_key, group_count, result_source, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select:
select from basket_division_grouping_batch
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select from basket_division_grouping_batch
where division_id = #{divisionId} and stage_id = #{stageId} and is_delete = 0 and active_unique_key is not null
limit 1

select coalesce(max(batch_version), 0) + 1 from basket_division_grouping_batch
where division_id = #{divisionId} and stage_id = #{stageId}

select
b.id as grouping_batch_id,
b.division_id,
d.division_name,
b.stage_id,
s.stage_code,
s.stage_name,
b.batch_version,
b.grouping_mode,
b.grouping_status,
b.group_count,
b.result_source,
b.confirmed_time,
b.create_time
from basket_division_grouping_batch b
left join basket_division d on d.id = b.division_id and d.is_delete = 0
left join basket_division_stage s on s.id = b.stage_id and s.is_delete = 0
where b.is_delete = 0
and b.division_id = #{divisionId}
and b.stage_id = #{stageId}
and b.grouping_status = #{groupingStatus}
order by b.batch_version desc, b.id desc
mapper.update:
update basket_division_grouping_batch
grouping_status = #{groupingStatus},
active_unique_key = null,
active_unique_key = #{activeUniqueKey},
result_source = #{resultSource},
confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy},
confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime},
update_by = #{updateBy},
update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

update basket_division_grouping_batch set is_delete = 1, active_unique_key = null, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
